title: 第11章 成功报仇完成任务第12章 获取奖励接取新任务
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
“不对，陆元可没有你这般年轻！”
魏凌空眉头紧皱，满脸狐疑之色，目光在陆玄合身上来回扫视着，似乎想要透过他的外表看穿其真实身份。
突然，他像是想到了什么，脸色骤变，惊呼道：“难不成……你竟是陆元的儿子，陆玄合？可当年你应该也死了才对，你是如何逃出去的？”
听到这话，陆玄合心头一震，他紧紧地盯着魏凌空，只见对方的眼神中不仅充满了杀气。
这一刹那，他明白了一切，找到了灭他全族的真正的凶手。
他就知道所谓齐国的报复只是一个谎言，以此来掩盖他的罪行，并且还可以出兵齐国。
就是此人当年屠戮了自己的家族！
陆玄合只觉得一股怒火直冲脑门，浑身气血翻涌，双目之中更是猛然迸射出一道凌厉至极的精光。
“魏凌空！
你为何要灭我陆家？我陆家一直安分守己，从不逾越。”
“呵呵，废话真多。
不过看在你主动送死的份上，就让你死得明明白白。”
“当年，你陆家可是我那已逝皇兄的忠实拥趸，我这胜利者岂会容忍你们这些余孽存在？”
“况且，你父亲一直不愿将兵权拱手相让，这叫我怎能高枕无忧？故而，我只得狠下心来，痛下杀手，并将所有罪责统统推给齐国。
如此一来，我便有了名正言顺的出兵借口，这岂不是一箭双雕之计？”
魏凌空面色阴鸷，冷笑连连。
“不过，让我想不通的是，为何你当年并没有死，并且逃了出去？”
“更没想到的是，你不好好苟延残喘，反而今日主动上门送死。
你不会觉得问心境就能报仇了吧。
就算算上你师父，也不过是飞蛾扑火，自取灭亡。”

“立即动手！
一个不留”
魏凌空突然下令，让禁卫军动手立即动手。
魏国三百禁军纷纷手持兵器，组成大阵，合力打出杀招，朝秦天阳师徒轰杀而来。
见他们一动不动，似乎被吓傻了。
魏凌空内心冷笑不已，不过是两个不知天高地厚的傻子罢了。
然而，秦天阳动手了，只见他随手一挥，连灵气波动都没有。
却见三百禁军包括那位洞天境首领一同纷纷炸裂开来，虚空中出现了三百道血雾。
一时间虚空中下起了血雨，血腥无比！
如此刺激的画面震惊了每一个人，眼球似乎都要被瞪了出来！
“什么？”
魏凌空呆傻在原地。
他不敢相信自己的禁卫军这么没了，包括那位洞天五重天的禁军首领，全军覆没！
要打造这么一支豪华的禁军，要花费无数代价，每年消耗的灵材，灵石都无可计数。
魏凌空彻底怒了，眼中满是怒火，花了那么多钱打造的禁卫军就这么没了。
content_en:
"No, Lu Yuan is not as young as you!"
Wei Lingkong frowned, his face full of suspicion, and his eyes glanced back and forth at Lu Xuanhe, as if he wanted to see through his appearance to see his true identity.
Suddenly, he seemed to have thought of something, his face suddenly changed, and he exclaimed: "Could it be that...you are Lu Yuan's son, Lu Xuanhe? But you should have died back then. How did you escape?"
Hearing this, Lu Xuanhe was shocked. He stared at Wei Lingkong closely, and saw that the other person's eyes were not only filled with murderous intent.
At this moment, he understood everything and found the real murderer who destroyed his entire family.
He knew that the so-called revenge of Qi was just a lie to cover up his crimes, and he could also send troops to Qi.
This is the man who massacred his own family back then!
Lu Xuanhe felt a surge of anger rushing straight to his forehead, blood surged all over his body, and a sharp light suddenly shot out from his eyes.
"Wei Lingkong!
Why do you want to destroy my Lu family? I, the Lu family, have always followed our own rules and never exceeded our limits. "
“Haha, there’s so much nonsense.
But since you took the initiative to die, I will let you die clearly. "
"Back then, you, the Lu family, were loyal supporters of my late brother. How could I, a victor, tolerate the existence of remnants like you?"
"Besides, your father has always been unwilling to give up military power, so how can I sit back and relax? Therefore, I had to be cruel, kill the person, and put all the blame on Qi State.
In this way, I have a legitimate excuse to send troops. Isn't this a plan that kills two birds with one stone? "
Wei Lingkong looked sinister and sneered again and again.
"However, what I can't figure out is why you didn't die and escaped?"
"What I didn't expect is that instead of just hanging on for a while, you took the initiative to come to die today.
You don’t think you can get revenge just by asking about your state of mind.
Even if you include your master, he is just a moth rushing to the flame, causing his own destruction. "
"Do it now!
Leave no one behind”
Wei Lingkong suddenly ordered the imperial guards to take action immediately.
The three hundred forbidden troops of the Wei State held weapons and formed a large formation. They worked together to launch killing moves and came towards Qin Tianyang's master and apprentice.
Seeing that they were motionless, they seemed to be frightened.
Wei Lingkong sneered inwardly, they were just two idiots who didn't know the heights of the world.
However, Qin Tianyang took action, and with just a wave of his hand, there was not even a wave of spiritual energy.
But they saw three hundred forbidden troops, including the Cave Heaven Realm leader, exploding together, and three hundred blood mist appeared in the void.
For a moment, blood rained down in the void, and it was extremely bloody!
Such an exciting scene shocked everyone, and their eyes seemed to pop out!
"What?"
Wei Lingkong stayed where he was.
He couldn't believe that his Imperial Guards were so gone, including the leader of the Imperial Guards from the fifth level of the Cave Heaven. The whole army was wiped out!
To build such a luxurious Forbidden Army requires countless costs, and countless spiritual materials and spiritual stones are consumed every year.
Wei Lingkong was completely angry, his eyes were full of anger, the Imperial Guards that he had spent so much money to build were just gone.
